_help: Equation (level-set) infill pattern - copy this file to the patterns folder
(one level up), rename it (the file name becomes the pattern id, e.g.
my_pattern.json -> 'my_pattern') and choose Patterns... -> Reload patterns.
The strand follows the curve f(x, y, z) = level at each layer height, like
the gyroid. x, y, z are scaled so that 2*pi equals one Period (the cell size
set in the Layers panel), so f must repeat every 2*pi along x, y and z.
Infill % works automatically: the line density of the curve is measured
Allowed: numbers, x y z pi e tau, + - * / ** (or ^) %, and the functions
sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh exp log sqrt abs sign
floor min max. Anything else is rejected (the equation is parsed, never
Tips: keep |level| small - a level outside f's range gives no curves; a
non-zero level thickens one side of a TPMS (graded porosity). Keys starting
